title: Your Own Unit Test Framework
requirements: Self-registering tests via static objects + macros (`__LINE__`, `##` token pasting for unique names)
`CHECK`, `REQUIRE`, `CHECK_THROWS_AS`, approximate float compare; expression decomposition to print both sides (`1 == 2` → "expected 1 == 2")
`std::source_location` for file/line; colored output; filtering by name; timing
Run tests in parallel with your thread pool; JUnit XML output for CI
